extracted.intended_audience: IP attorneys, law firms, AIPLA members, and researchers interested in IP practice economics and litigation/practice cost metrics
extracted.subtask_description: Extraction of the survey's metrics and reporting rules used in the AIPLA 2023 Economic Survey, covering litigation/post-grant cost categories, firm staffing and compensation metrics, insurance and training metrics, and the survey's statistical/reporting conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial case management (by amount at risk)
rubrics_metrics.description: Cost associated with initial case management for matters grouped by amount at risk (e.g., Less than $1M, $1-$10M, $10-$25M, Greater than $25M).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed for multiple practice areas (patent, trademark, copyright, trade secret) and broken out by location and type of practice (Q45*, Q47*, Q49*, Q50*).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusive of discovery, motions, and claim construction
rubrics_metrics.description: Costs that are inclusive of the phases of discovery, motions practice, and claim construction (where applicable), reported by amount at risk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used across litigation tables by amount at risk and by practice type/location (e.g., Patent Infringement Q45Ab/Q45Af etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusive of pre-trial, trial, post-trial, and appeal (when applicable)
rubrics_metrics.description: Costs that include pre-trial, trial, post-trial, and appeal phases, reported by amount at risk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears for multiple matter types and dollar brackets; indicates full-lifecycle litigation cost when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost of mediation (cost if dispute was resolved through mediation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Cost if the dispute was resolved through mediation (previously phrased as 'cost of mediation').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rephrased in 2023 to 'cost if dispute was resolved through mediation'; reported by amount at risk and practice area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correlation between amount at risk and overall attorney hours required to litigate
rubrics_metrics.description: Measure of how attorney hours correlate with the monetary amount at risk for a litigation matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported separately for matter types (Patent Q45E, Trademark Q47B, Copyright Q49B, Trade Secret Q50B).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total cost of asserting compared to total cost of defending
rubrics_metrics.description: Comparison of total cost to assert a claim versus total cost to defend a claim.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported for multiple matter types (e.g., Patent Q45F, Trademark Q47C, Copyright Q49C, Trade Secret Q50C).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost of asserting as percent of cost of defending
rubrics_metrics.description: The cost to assert expressed as a percentage of the cost to defend.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as a percent metric (e.g., Q45Fx, Q47Cx, Q49Cx, Q50Cx).

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-Grant Proceedings — Through filing petition
rubrics_metrics.description: Costs or metrics measured through the filing of a PGR/IPR petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported by technical area and by location/type of practice (Q46Ai series).

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-Grant Proceedings — Through end of motion practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Costs or metrics measured through the end of motion practice in a PGR/IPR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported by technical area and by location/type of practice (Q46Aii series).

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-Grant Proceedings — Through PTAB hearing
rubrics_metrics.description: Costs or metrics measured through the PTAB hearing stage of PGR/IPR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported by technical area and by location/type of practice (Q46Aiii series).

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-Grant Proceedings — Through appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Costs or metrics measured through appeal of a PGR/IPR decision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported by technical area and by location/type of practice (Q46Aiv series).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total cost of filing a petition compared to total cost of defending (post‑grant)
rubrics_metrics.description: Comparison of the total cost to file a PGR/IPR petition versus the total cost to defend against it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears as an overall post-grant cost comparison (Q46B).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost of filing as percent of cost of defending (post‑grant)
rubrics_metrics.description: The cost to file a post‑grant petition expressed as a percentage of the cost to defend.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as a percent metric for post-grant proceedings (Q46Bx).

rubrics_metrics.name: Litigation/ Opposition/ Cancellation — Through filing petition / End of discovery / Inclusive all costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Milestone-based cost reporting for opposition/cancellation matters (through filing petition, end of discovery, and inclusive/all costs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applied to trademark opposition/cancellation (Q48) and similar tables; reported by location and by type of practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total cost of arbitration compared to litigation
rubrics_metrics.description: Total cost of resolving a dispute through arbitration compared to resolving the dispute through litigation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as a comparative dollar metric (Q51).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost of arbitration as percent of cost of litigation
rubrics_metrics.description: Arbitration cost expressed as a percentage of litigation cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as a percent metric (Q51x).

rubrics_metrics.name: Frequency mediation/arbitration initiated in 2022
rubrics_metrics.description: How often mediation or arbitration was initiated in 2022.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as a frequency statistic (Q52).

rubrics_metrics.name: Position of the person responding on behalf of the firm
rubrics_metrics.description: The role/title of the individual completing the Firm portion of the survey (Q1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to identify respondent perspective for Firm Survey data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of office locations in 2022 by size of firm
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of office locations during 2022, broken out by firm size (Q3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported by size categories of firm.

rubrics_metrics.name: Firm has plan to close any major office locations in 2023 or 2024
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the firm plans to close any major office locations in the near term (Q4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Yes/no planning metric for office closures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anticipate changes to amount of office space leased or owned
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent expectation about changes to amount of office space leased or owned (Q5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captures anticipated changes post‑2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentage of employees working remotely
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of the firm's employees working remotely (Q6a-b).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remote work metric (was revised in 2023 survey changes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Solo practitioner indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the respondent is a solo practitioner (Q8).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary/descriptor used to segment firm data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of attorneys in the firm in 2022 by firm size
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of attorneys in 2022 broken out by firm size categories (Q9).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to frame many per-attorney and per-firm metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Counts of professionals primarily in IP by role, gender, and firm size
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of equity partners/shareholders, partner-track attorneys, non-partner track attorneys, of counsel, contract/part-time professionals, USPTO-registered patent agents, technical advisors/assistants (incl. searchers), and paralegal/legal assistants primarily practicing IP, each broken out by gender and firm size (Q10A–Q10H, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extensive gender-by-role-by-size breakout used for workforce demographics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Counts of professionals primarily in IP by role, ethnicity, and firm size
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of equity partners/shareholders, partner-track attorneys, non-partner track attorneys, of counsel, contract/part-time professionals, USPTO-registered patent agents, technical advisors/assistants, and paralegal/legal assistants primarily practicing IP, each broken out by ethnicity and firm size (Q10I–Q10P, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parallel ethnicity breakout to the gender breakout.

rubrics_metrics.name: Services that were outsourced in 2022
rubrics_metrics.description: List/count of services the firm outsourced during 2022 (Q11).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes litigation services as a newly added category in 2023.

rubrics_metrics.name: Services not outsourced in 2022 and AI tools used by firm
rubrics_metrics.description: Services that were not outsourced and whether AI tools were used when the service was not outsourced (Q11).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New in 2023: captures use of AI tools for in‑house services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of professionals whose practice is primarily IP who joined the firm in 2022 by firm size
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of IP-focused hires in 2022, broken out by firm size (Q12).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to measure hiring activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentage of attorneys hired through a recruiter (head hunter) by firm size
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of hires made via external recruiters, by firm size (Q13).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recruiting channel metric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average fee paid to recruiter as a % of salary by firm size
rubrics_metrics.description: Average recruiter fee expressed as a percentage of the new hire's salary (Q14).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported by firm size categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of professionals whose practice is primarily IP who left the firm in 2022 (including retired)
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of IP practitioners who left the firm during 2022 (Q15).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attrition metric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of associates in 2022 that were promoted
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of associates promoted in 2022 to non-equity partner and equity partner (Q16 and added question in 2023).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promotion metric (new detail added in 2023).

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of non-billable support staff devoted primarily to the IP practice by size of firm
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution counts of non-billable support staff allocated to IP practice, by firm size (Q17).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes number of non-billable support staff and non-billable support staff per IP attorney metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of non-billable support staff per IP attorney by firm size
rubrics_metrics.description: Ratio/count of non-billable support staff per IP attorney, by firm size (Q17).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to evaluate staffing support levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Firm plans to hire more summer associates in 2023 than 2022
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicator whether the firm plans to increase summer associate hires in 2023 vs. 2022 (Q18).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hiring intentions for summer programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of summer associates devoted primarily to IP law by year and firm size
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of summer associates focused on IP law for 2021 and 2022 by firm size (Q19A–Q19C).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported for multiple years and used alongside pay and expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monthly pay for summer associates devoted primarily to IP by size of firm
rubrics_metrics.description: Compensation (monthly pay) for summer associates focused on IP, by firm size (Q20).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pay benchmarking metric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of summer associates expected and 'Not sure' counts for 2023/2024
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of summer associates expected (Q21) and counts of respondents not sure of numbers for 2023 and 2024.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captures hiring expectations and uncertainty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of firm's billings in IP law by size of firm
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage of total firm billings attributable to IP law, reported by firm size (Q22–Q23).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to segment firms where IP is primary vs. not.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allocation of firm’s IP billings by size of firm and by type of work (including >=75% practice vs <75%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of IP billings by type of IP work and firm size, with separate tables when IP represents 75%+ of practice vs less than 75% (Q24 and related tables).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Different displays depending on IP concentration in the firm (Q24, pages F-33/F-34).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total 2022 billings for professional legal services
rubrics_metrics.description: Aggregate firm billings for legal services in 2022 (Q25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used with per-attorney metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total 2022 billings per attorney
rubrics_metrics.description: Per-attorney billing totals for 2022 (Q25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Benchmarks revenue per lawyer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Firm collections, billings, overhead, percent change in billings, and percent change in revenue
rubrics_metrics.description: Financial performance metrics including collections, billings, overhead, and year-over-year percent changes (Q26–Q29).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to assess firm financial health and trends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum, maximum, and average 2022 attorney billing rates for non-IP work
rubrics_metrics.description: Min/max and average billing rates charged for non-IP legal work in 2022 (Q30a–Q30c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported by firm size and used for benchmarking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum, maximum, and average 2022 attorney billing rates for IP work
rubrics_metrics.description: Min/max and average billing rates charged for IP work in 2022 (Q31a–Q31c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported by firm size and used for IP-specific benchmarking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current starting salary for a first-year associate
rubrics_metrics.description: Reported starting salary for first-year associates in the firm (Q32).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compensation benchmarking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average salary for a patent agent
rubrics_metrics.description: Average compensation for patent agents (Q33).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a salary benchmark for non-attorney IP professionals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average salary for an IP paralegal
rubrics_metrics.description: Average compensation for IP paralegals (Q34).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Paralegal pay benchmarking (new summary question added in 2023).

rubrics_metrics.name: Tuition reimbursement and loan forgiveness for patent agents or assistants attending law school
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether firms provide tuition reimbursement or loan forgiveness to patent agents/assistants attending law school (Q35).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Benefit/retention metric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Liability insurance coverage and deductible in 2022 by size of firm
rubrics_metrics.description: Type and level of professional liability insurance coverage and deductible amounts for 2022, by firm size (Q36 & Q39).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes cyber liability as reported in Q37; additional cyber liability questions were added in 2023.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cyber liability insurance detail
rubrics_metrics.description: Information provided in Q36 includes cyber liability insurance; follow-up questions ask if firm has cyber liability insurance (Q37–Q38).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Additional cyber liability questions were added for 2023.

rubrics_metrics.name: Liability insurance cost per attorney in 2022
rubrics_metrics.description: Per-attorney liability insurance costs in 2022 (Q40).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Financial cost benchmarking for insurance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of liability claims for IP matters made in the last five years
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of professional liability claims for IP matters in the prior five-year window (Q41).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also reported on a per-attorney basis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional liability insurance underwriters used by firms
rubrics_metrics.description: Which insurance underwriters firms used for professional liability coverage (Q42).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also includes cost per attorney by underwriter (Q42 tables).

rubrics_metrics.name: Amount spent on outside providers of attorney training and external attorney training programs as % of gross revenue
rubrics_metrics.description: Firm spending on outside attorney training expressed as a percentage of gross revenue for 2022 (Q43).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training investment metric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Firm provides formal training to attorneys
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicator whether the firm offers formal attorney training programs (Q44).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary/descriptive measure of internal training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Associates get billable hour credit for specified activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether associates receive billable-hour credit toward their billing requirement for time spent on specified activities: marketing, pro bono work, bar association participation, professional organization participation, RFP process, and newsletter drafting (Q45A–Q45F and expanded list in 2023).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The 2023 survey expanded and separated these activities; captures firm policies on billable-credit incentives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum responses required to report means/medians
rubrics_metrics.description: A minimum of three responses is required to show mean and median values in tables.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statistical reporting floor to avoid revealing identifiable data.

rubrics_metrics.name: ISD flag for insufficient data
rubrics_metrics.description: The term 'ISD' is used in tables to indicate insufficient data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used where counts are too small to report reliable statistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Omission of table rows with 1–2 respondents for anonymity
rubrics_metrics.description: Table rows with one or two respondents have been omitted to protect anonymity of respondents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applied to row-level breaks; tables with no valid rows are likewise omitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: General threshold: tables with fewer than 20 respondents generally not shown
rubrics_metrics.description: In general, tables with less than 20 respondents overall were not shown to maintain statistical reliability; exceptions were made in some cases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Location tables for typical charges and litigation-related matters were deleted when there were fewer than 20 respondents; corresponding tables by number of attorneys were kept.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quartiles and percentiles explanation
rubrics_metrics.description: Quartiles (first quartile, median, third quartile) are used to show distributions; quartiles are interpolated locations on a distribution and are equivalent to the 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains that quartiles may not represent actual reported values and gives an example of interpretation.
